one_line: Website-enforced authority controls for consequential WebMCP agent actions.
what_it_does: A simulated billing-dispute control plane lets agents inspect evidence, read live authority, propose corrections, attempt refunds, obtain exact human approval, and verify final state.
leverage_rationale: The core value is shared live authority and execution enforcement in the page; a general UI-driving agent cannot comparably guarantee exact limits, approval binding, and state-aware replanning.
leverage_evidence: About describes page-defined WebMCP tools for invoices, contracts, authority, refunds, approval, and verification.
Video frames show Control Center and an Edit refund authority flow with a blocked €1,200 action.
The agent rereads changed session authority and replans without restart.
execution_rationale: The central safety workflow is coherent and visibly exercised through authority editing, rejection, and dashboard states; the packet lacks transcript but has strong motion evidence.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show Control Center, refund-authority editing, and red blocked-action state.
About specifies the €500 limit, €800 delegated increase, €400 approval path, and final verification.
impact_rationale: Consequential agent actions involving refunds and sensitive business data have a clear real safety need, and the demonstrated boundary directly addresses it.
impact_evidence: Billing dispute scenario uses a verified €1,200 overcharge and prevents unauthorized movement of money.
Human approval is bound to exact action, amount, customer, and session.
creativity_rationale: The capability-versus-authority thesis is a strong, memorable interaction model that treats the website as the enforcement boundary rather than relying on prompts.
creativity_evidence: Distinct website-enforced authority concept.
Live re-planning after a session-only authority change is pursued deeply.
usability_note: Control Center and visible approval/error states make the safety model understandable, though the workflow is specialized.
advance_reason: Exceptional leverage with clear product-motion evidence and a credible consequential-action use case.

one_line: Explains hidden access paths and stages least-privilege remediation safely.
what_it_does: An offboarding workbench resolves identities, computes effective access, traces inherited paths, simulates removals, preserves dependencies, and produces a read-only receipt after human confirmation.
leverage_rationale: Structured graph/path analysis and staged remediation are materially more reliable than UI driving, especially for inherited permissions and dependency preservation, though the demo is synthetic.
leverage_evidence: About specifies nine imperative tools for identity resolution, effective access, path tracing, risk flagging, and simulation.
Video shows least-privilege dashboard and access-path analysis with 4 effective paths and 5 sensitive grants.
Visible confirmation gate keeps revocation outside WebMCP tools.
execution_rationale: The central workflow is unusually well scoped: it finds a breakage, revises the plan, stages five removals, preserves one dependency, and confirms only through a visible control.
execution_evidence: Frames show generated dashboard, access-path metrics, and no-access-changes-staged state.
About gives explicit rehearsal sequence and read-only receipt behavior.
impact_rationale: Security teams and administrators have a concrete high-value problem: safely removing offboarding access without breaking production dependencies.
impact_evidence: Synthetic Alex Morgan offboarding case includes production deploy and customer-data export access.
Workflow explains why grants exist and preserves a rollback dependency.
creativity_rationale: Permission-path explanation plus dependency-aware staged change is a fresh and ambitious interaction for access review.
creativity_evidence: Live SVG graph visualizes red risk paths and amber staged removals.
Plan is revised after discovering an operational dependency.
usability_note: Metrics, graph, staging, and confirmation boundary support reviewability; dense access concepts may challenge casual users.
red_flags: Synthetic/mock state rather than live IAM changes
advance_reason: Strong all-around submission with demonstrated workflow and meaningful WebMCP delta.

one_line: A unified HTML office document where deck, doc, spreadsheet, sketch, and chart coexist.
what_it_does: Origami creates and edits a single browser-native file containing presentations, prose, spreadsheets, diagrams, and embedded views, with an agent building structured content.
leverage_rationale: Page-native structured authoring lets an agent create and revise a cross-format artifact without brittle Office file manipulation; the same outcome remains possible with friction via UI automation.
leverage_evidence: About describes one HTML file with deck, document, spreadsheet, and chart content.
Frames show an agent-building state and resulting Venn diagram, process flow, critical path, and summary slides.
Agent can save, open, and resume browser-native files.
execution_rationale: The deck-building flow visibly produces multiple coherent structured pages and diagrams, though some repeated frames and incomplete drawing states suggest remaining rough edges.
execution_evidence: Frames show New fold, agent-building status, and populated multi-page deck.
Visible outputs include Venn, process, timeline, and explanatory slides.
impact_rationale: Knowledge workers who combine reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and diagrams have a real fragmentation problem, and a unified editable artifact directly addresses it.
impact_evidence: About explicitly targets Office fragmentation and cross-document embedding.
Generated deck includes several practical business-document structures.
creativity_rationale: Replacing separate Office metaphors with a single fold/file and letting documents contain live cross-format blocks is highly original and ambitious.
creativity_evidence: One file/every tool concept.
Documents, spreadsheets, decks, sketches, and charts are treated as one composable artifact.
usability_note: Unified editing is compelling, but the breadth of formats and block model may need polish and onboarding.
red_flags: Some drawing state appears blank or in-progress
advance_reason: Distinctive concept with strong visible generated results and substantial agent leverage.

one_line: A turn-based knowledge-tree learning game shared by a human and a tool-constrained voice agent.
what_it_does: Players alternate turns growing a knowledge tree with concepts, resources, skills, and gaps; the voice agent can modify the board only through registered WebMCP tools.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP is the game’s rule-enforced agent controller and shared board state; generic UI driving would undermine the explicit no-cheating and turn-taking contract.
leverage_evidence: About defines six move tools, ten alternating turns, and human-only undo.
Frames show the evolving tree-like board and changing game states.
Agent is constrained to page-registered moves.
execution_rationale: The frames show a functioning interactive canvas progression, while the packet describes clear rules and win conditions; exact voice/tool transcript is absent.
execution_evidence: Frames show successive board states with growing green node structures and later state changes.
About specifies node types, moves, turn count, and win condition.
impact_rationale: Learners benefit from structured active recall and visible knowledge gaps, with entertainment and voice interaction improving engagement.
impact_evidence: Turn-based learning around a single question is a concrete study use case.
Node types distinguish concepts, resources, skills, and unresolved gaps.
creativity_rationale: A competitive/cooperative board-game grammar for human-agent learning, combined with anti-cheating tool constraints, is memorable and novel.
creativity_evidence: Human and voice agent alternate turns on a shared knowledge canvas.
Tool-only agent moves and human-only undo are central mechanics.
usability_note: Rules and visual tree make the interaction approachable; voice-agent reliability is not fully evidenced.
red_flags: Tool invocation details are not legible in frame sheets and no transcript is supplied
standouts: Learning and play reinforce each other
advance_reason: Highly original, clearly useful learning interaction where WebMCP changes the rules of play.

one_line: A trust workbench for inspecting, approving, verifying, auditing, and undoing agent actions.
what_it_does: OpenAgentLab tests WebMCP tools against an issue tracker while Action Ledger previews consequential operations, gates approval, records tamper-evident outcomes, and supports reversible undo.
leverage_rationale: Structured previews, approval binding, verification, and replay/undo address trust properties that ordinary browser automation does not provide reliably.
leverage_evidence: About lists search_issues, get_issue, close_issue, and delete_issue with governance around mutation.
Frames show Tool Explorer metadata, schemas, close_issue execution, and success output.
Ledger records verified outcomes and real undo where supported.
execution_rationale: The tool explorer and execution flow are visibly coherent, but the packet’s frame resolution limits confirmation of the full ledger lifecycle.
execution_evidence: Frames show Tools navigation, registered-tool metrics, schemas, and structured output.
About specifies preview, approval, verification, audit, evaluation, and undo.
impact_rationale: Agent reliability and accountability is a central problem for developers deploying state-changing tools; the solution directly targets it.
impact_evidence: Issue tracker scenario contrasts close versus permanent delete and asks whether mutations actually occurred.
Human approval and postcondition verification are explicit product functions.
creativity_rationale: The combination of tool-contract testing, action governance, and an auditable ledger is a strong systems-level synthesis.
creativity_evidence: Action Ledger treats agent operations as inspectable, verifiable records.
Undo and duplicate-mutation concerns are designed into the interaction.
usability_note: Developer-oriented explorer is structured but dense; broader trust workflows are not all visually obvious.
red_flags: No public repository and demo_alive is unknown
standouts: Tool contract and action lifecycle coverage
advance_reason: High impact and meaningful agent-safety infrastructure with visible tool execution evidence.

one_line: A voice-controlled, agent-and-human notebook for study, diagrams, drawings, projects, and code.
what_it_does: Agents create and revise inspectable notebook pages, including anatomy study modules, diagrams, drawings, and interactive content, while humans review the shared artifact.
leverage_rationale: Typed page contracts and shared visible state improve reliable artifact creation over chat or UI driving, but the broad notebook capabilities are not all uniquely dependent on WebMCP.
leverage_evidence: About says the page publishes a small typed contract that the notebook owns.
Frames show populated notebook-like content and interactive canvas states.
Agent can read, open, and revise visible pages.
execution_rationale: The packet demonstrates a broad set of coherent demos and visible notebook outputs, though its scope is intentionally a collection of tech demos.
execution_evidence: About describes live Instruction Notebook, anatomy recall, skull coloring, and project pages.
Frames show evolving visual content and controls across notebook states.
impact_rationale: Students and creators have a real need for persistent artifacts rather than ephemeral voice-chat answers; the study and sketch use cases are credible.
impact_evidence: Anatomy Exam Prep provides a specific educational audience and interactive lab use case.
Notebook preserves work for inspection, revisiting, and correction.
creativity_rationale: Turning voice-agent collaboration into a persistent multimodal notebook with embedded interactive pages is an ambitious and fresh synthesis.
creativity_evidence: Agent creates actual notebook artifacts instead of only answers.
Anatomy coloring lab and nested visual demos pursue the concept beyond plain notes.
usability_note: Persistent pages and human inspection are useful, but the many modes may make the product feel diffuse.
red_flags: Broad scope makes one central workflow difficult to identify
Tool calls are not clearly legible without transcript
advance_reason: Useful and ambitious shared notebook with credible visible artifact creation.

one_line: An agent-native sourcing copilot for turning product ideas into manufacturer-ready plans.
what_it_does: Founders build a living product brief, explore packaging, research manufacturer matches with evidence and unknowns, and prepare reviewed outreach without autonomous sending.
leverage_rationale: A shared structured brief, explicit evidence/unknown handling, and manufacturer-specific outreach are materially improved by page-native tools over ad hoc UI operation.
leverage_evidence: About describes agent-assisted decisions on format, volume, shelf life, packaging, and market.
Frames show agent-native document collaboration and packaging/manufacturer workflow surfaces.
Unknowns, conflicts, sources, and review dates remain visible.
execution_rationale: The product presents a coherent sourcing flow with evidence-aware matching and explicit approval boundaries; motion evidence is visible but small.
execution_evidence: About specifies product brief, 3D packaging direction, matching explanations, and reviewed drafts.
Frames show collaboration/package-design states.
impact_rationale: Small founders and emerging food brands face a concrete, confusing manufacturing-sourcing problem that this workflow directly reduces.
impact_evidence: Banana-bread manufacturing origin grounds a specific founder audience.
Product addresses inconsistent manufacturer information and unknown requirements.
creativity_rationale: Combining sourcing research, evidence provenance, product specification, packaging, and controlled outreach is a notably original workflow.
creativity_evidence: Matches explain why each manufacturer appeared and do not hide missing information.
Separate founder approval for shared information and sending is integrated.
usability_note: Progressive brief and visible unknowns support trust; manufacturing terminology may still require guidance.
red_flags: Manufacturer data appears synthetic or limited in the packet
advance_reason: High-impact niche workflow with strong structured collaboration and responsible outreach design.

one_line: A privacy-preserving WebMCP page that rewrites guarded website copy to match visitor context.
what_it_does: The visitor’s agent supplies context locally; one guarded write updates 29 text fields, stages a reveal, and allows one-click restoration of the original page.
leverage_rationale: The page itself owns the writing contract, field budgets, facts, and restoration state; this visitor-side personalization is difficult to replicate comparably with generic UI automation or server profiling.
leverage_evidence: About says context and rewritten text never leave the browser and no account is required.
One write_all call updates 29 guarded fields under page-defined rules.
Frames show personalized landing-page states and staged reveal behavior.
execution_rationale: The deterministic headline phase, guarded 29-field write, and restore behavior form a clear core flow, though detailed final outputs are small in the frames.
execution_evidence: About specifies under-one-second deterministic reminting, skeleton reveal, and restoration.
Frames show dark marketing-page variants and updated copy states.
impact_rationale: Sales and ecommerce visitors have a real relevance problem, and local context avoids surveillance while improving messaging and conversion clarity.
impact_evidence: Examples target industrial sales and outdoor-apparel ecommerce contexts.
Form can be prefilled from agent-held profile context without server-side profiling.
creativity_rationale: Inverting personalization so the visitor’s agent writes the page, under a page-owned contract, is a novel interaction and privacy model.
creativity_evidence: Context stays visitor-side rather than using cookies, trackers, or backend profiles.
The site is written by the agent rather than merely operated by it.
usability_note: Fast one-call personalization and restore are simple; copy quality and safety of arbitrary context remain considerations.
standouts: Large guarded batch update with instant rollback
advance_reason: A genuinely new page-native personalization pattern with clear leverage and visible product states.

one_line: A reviewable studio for converting an owner-authorized legacy workflow into narrow WebMCP tools.
what_it_does: The studio scans a bundled synthetic booking fixture, presents evidence, lets an owner approve candidate read/stage tools, validates behavior, and exports a clean-room package while keeping finalization outside the tool surface.
leverage_rationale: It addresses the hard capability-contract boundary directly: structured tools are derived from observed workflow evidence with owner authorization and explicit finalization separation.
leverage_evidence: About specifies five inspectable steps from inert scan through validation and export.
Exactly three narrow tools are registered; finalize_booking is deliberately absent.
Frames show the staged synthetic workflow and interface states.
execution_rationale: The product is tightly scoped and safety-conscious, with clear states, evidence retention, validation, and export; video frames provide substantial workflow evidence.
execution_evidence: About details ownership authorization, hashes, candidate capabilities, contract inspection, and validation.
Frames show the retrofit studio workflow across multiple stages.
impact_rationale: Owners of legacy sites need a practical way to expose dependable agent capabilities without granting uncontrolled mutation access.
impact_evidence: Synthetic booking fixture models common form/button-only workflows.
No credentials, arbitrary crawling, deployment, or real booking are required.
creativity_rationale: A clean-room, evidence-backed retrofit pipeline with an intentional finalization boundary is a strong and original developer-tool concept.
creativity_evidence: Owner-authorized inert scan turns legacy UI observations into reviewed contracts.
Read-only and reversible draft staging are explicitly distinguished.
usability_note: Five-step review flow is clear and safe, though intended for technical owners rather than end users.
red_flags: Only bundled synthetic fixture is demonstrated
advance_reason: Strongly WebMCP-native infrastructure with unusually disciplined safety and evidence design.

one_line: A clinician-led command center where agents prepare review from simulated care observations.
what_it_does: The system aggregates simulated camera/mobile observations, filters and summarizes them, routes items to clinician review, coordinates staff tasks, and logs training-drill state without autonomous clinical action.
leverage_rationale: Structured source filtering, observation preparation, role coordination, and explicit review state are valuable agent capabilities beyond generic dashboard clicking, though the environment is simulated.
leverage_evidence: About lists six WebMCP tools for command-center summary, observation filtering, review preparation, and staff coordination.
Frames show source feeds, clinician review queue, filters, prepared observation, and training drill state.
No automated diagnosis or treatment order is permitted.
execution_rationale: The visible command center and review queue form a coherent safety-first workflow, with strong screenshot evidence but no transcript and simulated data.
execution_evidence: Frames visibly show overview, source filters, human review preparation, and local drill mutation.
About explicitly states no external staff messaging and simulated environment.
impact_rationale: Clinicians and care teams have a real coordination burden, and safely preparing context for human review can create substantial value without automating diagnosis.
impact_evidence: Doctor-led command center addresses camera, mobile, staff-call, and task-list fragmentation.
Human review boundary is central to the design.
creativity_rationale: The product pursues an important middle ground between passive clinical dashboards and unsafe autonomous care agents.
creativity_evidence: Agent coordinates evidence and staff roles while explicitly avoiding clinical action.
Training drill changes local state without external messaging.
usability_note: Source filters and review queue support clinician workflow; simulated data limits real-world validation.
red_flags: Clinical impact is preparatory rather than diagnostic
advance_reason: Credible healthcare coordination use case with strong safety posture and visible product workflow.
